comment: RELG 235 - Graybill is a lovely, amazing professor! Graded only on essays/reflections, and you can revise anything for a better grade. Participating is important and she tries to make every class engaging!

Dr. Graybill is the best professor ever, by far the best I have taken at UR. I have taken three of her classes so far and plan to take more. She is so understanding and so knowledgeable. You can tell she loves what she teaches and she respects her students so deeply!

Dr. Graybill is absolutely brilliant. This is my third class with her, and I could not speak more highly of her. She is so knowledgeable about the subject and helps students to grow in their learning and i know so much more because of her
I love Dr. Graybill - very respectful of student busyness, very knowledgeable about what she teaches, and open to all perspectives! Definitely my favorite professor; I have learned so much from her!
